name: Sloan Peak
range: Henry M. Jackson Wilderness · Mountain Loop
blurb: A sharp fin above the North Fork Sauk, climbed by a ledge that spirals around the summit tower: the Corkscrew.
permit: Northwest Forest Pass. Free self-issued wilderness permit at the trailhead.

routes.name: Corkscrew
routes.summary: Log crossings of the North Fork Sauk, a steep trail up Cougar Creek to meadows, across the Sloan Glacier, then exposed ledges that wrap around the summit tower.

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Sloan Peak TH
waypoints.note: Pullout on the North Fork Sauk River Road just past Garnet Creek.

waypoints.name: Cougar Creek meadows
waypoints.note: Marshy meadows; better camps higher up.

waypoints.name: Ridge camp
waypoints.note: Heather benches on the ridge overlooking the glacier, with running water nearby.

sections.note: Three crossings of the North Fork Sauk in the first half mile, then a steep trail up Cougar Creek.
Heather and snow to camps on the ridge above the glacier.
Across the Sloan Glacier from its north side to the southeast corner.
The Corkscrew: a broad ledge west across the south face, then class 3 rock to the summit.

pois.name: North Fork Sauk crossings
pois.note: Log crossings that change from year to year. Dangerous at high water and on hot afternoons.
